EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk

IT is hereby notified that HIS EXCELLENCY THE PRESIDENT of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka andCommander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces has been graciously pleased to confer the Gallantry Awards of Parama WeeraVibhushanaya, Weerodara Vibhushanaya, Weera Wickrema Vibhushanaya, Rana Wickrema Padakkama, Rana Sura Padakkamaon the 27th day of October in the Year Two Thousand Sixteen, to the persons named in the schedule hereto.
By His Excellency’s Command, P. B. ABEYKOON,Secretary to the President.
N.B.– Sinhala and Tamil versions are published separately.
